rationale: Keep one active Canadian hospital PPP under the display name Kelowna and Vernon Hospitals Project and add Infusion Health KVH General Partnership as its legal ProjectCo alias. Direct evidence establishes BBGI's initial 50% close in 2013, its purchase of the remaining 50% on August 19, 2020 and its continuing 100% ownership in April 2026. Retire Equitix's existing active period on August 19, 2020 and preserve both Equitix and Dalmore Capital as former indirect Jura/JLIF owners from 2018 to 2020. BCI's later acquisition of BBGI is an upstream manager transaction, not a separate ProjectCo ownership period.

companyFieldUpdates.name: Kelowna and Vernon Hospitals Project
companyFieldUpdates.description: Kelowna and Vernon Hospitals Project is an availability-based healthcare PPP in British Columbia whose legal ProjectCo is Infusion Health KVH General Partnership. The DBFM project covers four facilities across the Kelowna General Hospital and Vernon Jubilee Hospital campuses, together with lifecycle obligations for existing infrastructure, and operates for Interior Health under an agreement running to August 2042. BBGI completed an initial 50% acquisition on November 14, 2013 and acquired the remaining 50% on August 19, 2020; BBGI continued to describe the ProjectCo as wholly owned in April 2026. Equitix- and Dalmore-backed Jura held indirect exposure to the other 50% through JLIF from September 2018 until BBGI's 2020 acquisition. BCI's 2025 acquisition of BBGI is upstream and is not recorded as a separate ProjectCo owner. Interior Health is the public counterparty, the named hospitals are facilities, and Black & McDonald is a contractor rather than an owner. No later ProjectCo sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
